book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第一册
unit_cn: Unit 5 Revealing Nature 揭示自然
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第一册 Unit 5 词表(p49-59 真词)+ 课文/活动核心词;IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、自然/科学/发现主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Scientists are always trying to reveal the secrets of nature.
words.example_cn: 科学家们一直在努力揭示自然的奥秘。

words.example_en: Each year scientists identify many new species of plants and animals.
words.example_cn: 每年科学家都会鉴定出许多动植物新物种。

words.example_en: Darwin believed that birds evolve as they adapt to their environment.
words.example_cn: 达尔文认为鸟类随着适应环境而进化。

words.example_en: The theory of evolution changed how people understand nature.
words.example_cn: 进化论改变了人们对自然的理解。

words.example_en: The finches had evolved from a common ancestor.
words.example_cn: 这些雀鸟是从一个共同的原种进化而来的。

words.example_en: Darwin began to suspect that species could change over time.
words.example_cn: 达尔文开始猜想物种会随时间而改变。

words.example_en: A bean plant can detect the chemicals released by an injured neighbour.
words.example_cn: 豆类植物能察觉到受伤邻株释放的化学物质。

words.example_en: His journey on the Beagle helped him generate a completely new idea.
words.example_cn: 他在贝格尔号上的航行帮助他产生了一个全新的想法。

words.example_en: Each species has developed its own physical characteristics.
words.example_cn: 每个物种都发展出了自己独特的身体特征。

words.example_en: Animals slowly adapt to a changing environment in order to survive.
words.example_cn: 动物为了生存会慢慢适应不断变化的环境。

words.example_en: Darwin studied living things in their natural environment.
words.example_cn: 达尔文在自然环境中研究各种生物。

words.example_en: His cabin was crowded with samples of plants and animals.
words.example_cn: 他的船舱里堆满了动植物标本。

words.example_en: As a geologist, Darwin was fascinated by rocks and the land.
words.example_cn: 作为地质学家,达尔文对岩石和土地着迷。

words.example_en: Darwin's curiosity about living things made him a great naturalist.
words.example_cn: 达尔文对生物的好奇使他成为伟大的博物学家。

words.example_en: His adventures led to one of the most important scientific discoveries of all time.
words.example_cn: 他的探险带来了有史以来最重要的科学发现之一。

words.example_en: Darwin's scientific studies were so convincing that people began to believe him.
words.example_cn: 达尔文的科学研究极有说服力,人们开始相信他。

words.example_en: All the iguanas have developed from more primitive ones.
words.example_cn: 所有鬣蜥都是从更原始的种类发展而来的。

words.example_en: Mangroves serve as the habitat for various birds and fish.
words.example_cn: 红树林是各种鸟类和鱼类的栖息地。

words.example_en: Coastal plants are very important to the local ecosystem.
words.example_cn: 海岸植物对当地生态系统非常重要。

words.example_en: Iguanas have a very special appearance, with spines on their back.
words.example_cn: 鬣蜥外貌很特别,背上长着刺。

words.example_en: After goats were brought in, the tortoise population began to decline.
words.example_cn: 山羊被引入后,陆龟数量开始减少。

words.example_en: The extinction of the tortoise is blamed on humans.
words.example_cn: 这种陆龟的灭绝被归咎于人类。

words.example_en: This fungal network can link nearly every plant in a forest.
words.example_cn: 这个真菌网络几乎能把森林里的每株植物连接起来。

words.example_en: The wood wide web links the roots of different plants to each other.
words.example_cn: “木维网”把不同植物的根彼此连接起来。

words.example_en: She watched the seed slowly grow into a tall green plant.
words.example_cn: 她看着种子慢慢长成一株高高的绿色植物。

words.example_en: The captain wanted someone who would profit from visiting distant countries.
words.example_cn: 船长想找一个能从游历遥远国度中获益的人。

words.example_en: His father once predicted that he would be a disgrace to the family.
words.example_cn: 他父亲曾预言他会成为家族的耻辱。

words.example_en: The finches on each island had different beaks.
words.example_cn: 每座岛上的雀鸟都长着不同的喙。

words.example_en: Their beaks had evolved according to the food available on each island.
words.example_cn: 它们的喙随各岛可获取的食物而进化。

words.example_en: Lonesome George was the last Pinta Island tortoise.
words.example_cn: “孤独的乔治”是最后一只平塔岛陆龟。

words.example_en: After goats were brought to the island, the tortoises lost their food.
words.example_cn: 山羊被带到岛上后,陆龟失去了食物。

words.example_en: Mangroves are coastal plants that grow in or near water.
words.example_cn: 红树是生长在水中或水边的海岸植物。

words.example_en: Iguanas have comb-like spines along their back.
words.example_cn: 鬣蜥背上长着梳子状的刺。

words.example_en: Talking plants have long been a thing of myths and legends.
words.example_cn: 会说话的植物长久以来都是神话传说中的事物。

words.example_en: Many cultures have legends of talking trees that give advice.
words.example_cn: 许多文化中都有会给人建议的会说话的树的传说。

words.example_en: Some chemicals attract wasps that kill the harmful insects.
words.example_cn: 有些化学物质会吸引黄蜂来杀死有害昆虫。

words.example_en: Scientists hope we can grow crops without using pesticides.
words.example_cn: 科学家希望我们能不用杀虫剂就种出庄稼。

words.example_en: A chilli plant can tell if a neighbouring plant is friendly.
words.example_cn: 辣椒植株能分辨邻近的植物是否友好。

words.example_en: The wood wide web is linked underground by fungi, a kind of fungus.
words.example_cn: “木维网”由地下的真菌连接而成。

words.example_en: The wood wide web has its own version of cybercrime.
words.example_cn: “木维网”也有自己版本的网络犯罪。

words.example_en: Each stem had grown to around twenty centimetres tall.
words.example_cn: 每根茎都长到了约二十厘米高。

words.example_en: The Galápagos Islands are renowned worldwide for their biodiversity.
words.example_cn: 加拉帕戈斯群岛因其生物多样性而闻名全世界。

words.example_en: The reserve is home to several species of giant tortoise.
words.example_cn: 这个保护区是好几种巨型陆龟的家园。

words.example_en: Iguanas can be found on several of the islands.
words.example_cn: 在好几座岛上都能发现鬣蜥。

words.example_en: The young man who answered the call was not the captain's first choice.
words.example_cn: 响应号召的那个年轻人并不是船长的首选。

words.example_en: Several species of tortoise are native to the Galápagos Islands.
words.example_cn: 好几种陆龟原产于加拉帕戈斯群岛。

words.example_en: The island is home to many rare plants and animals.
words.example_cn: 这座岛是许多珍稀动植物的家园。

words.example_en: This fungal network links the roots of different plants.
words.example_cn: 这个真菌网络把不同植物的根连接起来。
